title: 第十章 县衙命案
content_zh:
夜空如洗，繁星点缀。
大奉京城最高建筑，观星楼，司天监的办公地点。
黄裙少女步履轻盈的攀登而上，经过第七层时，听见丹室传来一阵嘈杂的喧哗。
一群穿白衣的炼金术师，争吵的面红耳赤。
“为什么又失败了？明明是这么简单的步骤。”
“我说过了，肯定是盐的剂量不对。”
“不，我觉得是水。”
“是火吧？刚才我看到万师兄把盐给燃沸了。”
“太难了，盐变银子的炼金法术太难了，我不会啊。”
名叫采薇的黄裙少女嘴角抽了抽，嘀咕道：“这群人竟然还在炼假银子。”
两天前，她把盐变银子的事迹带回司天监，师兄们开始不信。
盐能变成银子？
三岁稚童都不信。
但很快，税银案告破，陛下觉得假银子威力极大，颇为神异，责令钦天监炼制假银。
于是，钦天监的炼金术师们开始了爆肝的工作，没日没夜的投入到996的福报中。
从两天前，一直肝到现在，屡败屡战，屡战屡败。
“采薇，是采薇师妹。”有人兴奋的喊了一声。
瞬间，一张张憔悴的脸转过来，一双双眼睛骤放精光。
“采薇师妹，这假银子到底是如何炼出来的。”
“采薇师妹，快过来帮我看看，是不是步骤出了问题？你是唯一一个成功炼制出假银的人。”

把黄裙少女团团围住。
褚采薇只好进入丹室，观看师兄们炼制假银的过程。
“又失败了！”一位现场操作的白衣炼金术师哀叹。
“采薇师妹，是哪里出问题了？”众白衣摆出虚心求教的姿态。
没有问题啊，我当初也是这么炼制的....褚采薇沉吟道：“此乃上古流传的炼金术，深奥晦涩，不是说学会就学会的，需深入浅出的授业，方能根深蒂固。我传授诸位师兄一句口诀，切记切记。”
师兄们摆出倾听姿态。
“氢氦锂铍硼碳氮氧氟氖钠镁铝硅磷！”褚采薇气运丹田，一字一句，吐出了这个了不起的口诀。
“此诀和解呀？”师兄们不明觉厉，每个字都听懂了，组合在一起就懵了。
我也不知道这是什么东西....褚采薇故作高深的微笑不语。
“奇才，奇才，写出此口诀的人，真乃炼金术的奇才。”一位白衣师兄感慨道。
奇才在哪里啊，师兄你别胡思乱想！褚采薇笑容不变。
“采薇师妹，这口诀是何人告诉你的。师妹是不是遇到了炼金术的高人，得其指点？”
褚采薇心说，问得好！把锅轻飘飘的甩了出去。
“那人叫许七安，御刀营七品绿袍许平志的侄子，你们找他便是了。”
一听是个武夫，白衣们不高兴了。
“笑话，我堂堂司天监，人才济济，炼制假银还要找外人？”
“而且还是个武夫。”
“传出去岂不成了笑话。”
根据修行体系不同，形成了几条非常有意思的鄙视链。
道门看不起佛门，佛门反鄙之。

术士看不起巫师，巫师看不起蛊师，蛊师又看不起术士。
然后，道佛术士巫师和蛊师，一起看不起武夫。
至于儒家，对不起，恕我直言，在座的各位都是垃圾。
不过近代儒家已经衰弱了。
“采薇师妹，你来指导我们吧。”
采薇‘呵’了一声：“下次一定！”
她从白衣师兄群里硬挤出去，继续拾阶而上。
其实，她也不懂。
上次在府衙，一气呵成的炼成假银，事后采薇私底下又尝试了一次，失败了。
完全复制了之前的过程，但就是失败了，她也不知道为什么。
观星楼的楼顶，不是正常的檐顶，而是一个八角形的平台，暗合八卦。
因此被称为八卦台。
八卦台的边缘，一个白衣老者，伏在案前，手里捏着酒杯，另一手拄着脑袋，似醉非醉，望着下方的京城。
黄裙少女识趣的没有打扰，师尊平日里不做正事，就喜欢坐在八卦台喝酒，看风景。
还不喜有人打扰。
拈杯酒眯着眼，说专心看人间。
“采薇来了？”白衣老者笑道。
“师父。”黄裙少女绽放笑容，小跑着过来，站在八卦边缘，裙裾飞扬。
“皇帝老儿有什么奖赏？”
“几百两银子，几匹绸缎。”黄裙少女说：“师父，假银子到底是什么东西？”

“为师不知呀。”
“世上还有师父不知道的东西？”
“太多太多。”白衣老者笑呵呵道：“师父不知道十九年前那几个小偷去了哪里。”
“您总说十九年前的小贼可恨，可也不告诉我，他们是谁，偷走了什么。”
白衣老者起身，站在八角台边缘，唉声叹气：“偷走的东西了不得啊。”
“那您知道假银子是谁炼制的吗。”司天监是术士体系的发源地，天底下的炼金术师，即使不是出身司天监，也必定和司天监有渊源。
税银案背后，有一个炼金术师参与其中，且炼出了这种奇物，绝非泛泛之辈。
“为师自然是知道的。”
.......
小院，正屋。
许七安躺在床上，借着窗外透进来的皓月，直愣愣的盯着纵横交错的房梁。
他在为自己的前程担忧，有些惶恐茫然，又有些热血沸腾。
凭我身为九年制义务教育出产的优质品，脑子里的知识全是挂。
轻易就能在落后的君主制社会里脱颖而出，成为最秀的一枝花。
然而，皇权至上的社会，往往意味着人权无法保障，今天会所嫩模，明天充军流放。
这是让任何一个现代人都会倍感忧愁的现象。
想着想着，许七安便睡着了，醒来时天光大亮，他穿好玄色公差服，系好腰带，束好长发，再把朴刀挂在腰间。
身姿笔挺，阳刚俊朗。
不得不承认，古代的服装对颜值和气质都有加成，就是上厕所时太麻烦了。
翻墙到二叔家蹭了顿早餐，叔侄俩一起出门上班，许平志官复原职，一切照旧。

长乐县衙是京城的附郭县，衙门就在城里，距离许宅有六七里的路程，许七安没有马，也没马车，只好乘着11号公交车，两刻钟就到了县衙。
长乐县衙坐北朝南，门口两尊与人等高的石狮子，红棕漆的大门两侧，摆着油漆剥落的大鼓。
县衙的结构很值得说道，最大的当然是知县，叫做主官，他有两个副手，一个是县丞，一个是主簿。
这三位是有品级的朝廷命官，搁在许七安那个年代，就是有编制的。
三位朝廷命官之下，是典史，又称首领官。
但没有品级，不入流。
接着是三班六房：三班是皂班、快班、壮班，负责仪仗、治安、缉捕之类；而六房对应朝廷六部。
许七安就是快班里的差役，明间称为捕快。
进了衙门，恰好典吏在点卯，站在堂前的李典史看见了腰胯朴刀的许七安，愣了愣。
那表情，仿佛青天白日见了鬼。
衙役们察觉到领导神色不对，纷纷转头看来，然后，也是同款的见鬼表情。
“许，许七安，你是人是鬼？！”有人颤声道。
李典史注意到许七安投在地面的影子，心里微松，语气镇定：“公堂之上说什么胡话，鬼有影子吗？”
众人闻言，齐齐松了口气。
许七安想了想，接茬：“说不得是行尸走肉。”
李典史大惊，众衙役心里一紧。
许七安连忙抱拳：“开个玩笑，见过典史大人，诸位同僚，我出狱了。”
李典史问道：“怎么回事？”
许家因为税银案入狱，他们是听说了的。
“自然是将功赎罪，戴罪立功，圣上宽容，赦免了许家的罪责。”许七安当即把事儿又复述了一遍，但把功劳推给了二叔，并取出京兆府衙门给的凭证。

同时心里也有数了，虽说税银已经找到，但判决还没下来，也就是说税银失踪案还没有尘埃落定，毕竟得走流程，没那么快。
因此，长乐县衙的这伙衙役还不知道此事。
点卯结束，几个相熟的捕快立刻凑上来，道贺恭喜。
“宁宴，你可得请客喝酒。”
在这个时代，称呼友人，用字不用名。自我介绍时，用名不用字。
“对，大难不死必有后福，得请客。”
“我听说临水街那家勾栏，新买了一批清倌人，宁宴，今晚与咱们一起去？”
请客喝酒倒是可以，睡女人还要我请，过分了....许七安刚想推脱说没钱，忽然脚下踩到了硬疙瘩，低头一看，竟是一粒碎银。
还真是大难不死必有后福？他立刻踩住，不动声色，假装看四处的风景。
等众人走前几步，许七安快速低头捡起，面不改色的收入钱囊。
走过长廊，在西侧的偏厅坐了几分钟后，李典史脸色阴沉的进来了，望向王捕头：“老王，县令老爷让我们去一趟内堂。”
王捕头脸色一苦，闷不吭声的出去了。
许七安目送王捕头的背影消失，问道：“怎么回事，头儿的脸色不太好看。”
“你蹲大狱这几天，康平街出了一起命案，死的是一个颇有钱势的商贾，县令老爷大发雷霆，每天都要逮着王捕头痛骂。”
“只是死了个商贾，县令老爷没必要大发雷霆吧。”许七安嗑着瓜子。
自古人命皆是大案，但身为京城附郭县的县令，从五品，不至于这般。
“呵，那商贾和给事中的某位大人沾亲带故的关系，想来是那边给了压力。”那衙役说：“而且，今年是庚子年啊。”
“庚子年？”许七安没反应过来。
“京察！”衙役点明。
content_en:
The night sky is clear and dotted with stars.
The tallest building in Dafeng Capital, the Star Observation Tower, is the office of Si Tianjian.
The girl in the yellow skirt climbed up with light steps. When she passed the seventh floor, she heard a loud noise coming from the alchemy room.
A group of alchemists dressed in white were quarreling with red faces.
"Why did it fail again? It was such a simple step."
"I told you, it must be the wrong dose of salt."
"No, I think it's water."
"Is it fire? Just now I saw Senior Brother Wan boiling the salt."
"It's too difficult. The alchemical spell of turning salt into silver is too difficult. I don't know how to do it."
The girl in the yellow dress named Caiwei twitched her lips and muttered: "These people are still refining fake silver."
Two days ago, she brought the story of turning salt into silver back to Si Tianjian, and the senior brothers began not to believe it.
Can salt turn into silver?
Even a three-year-old child wouldn't believe it.
But soon, the tax money case was solved. His Majesty felt that the counterfeit silver was extremely powerful and miraculous, so he ordered Qin Tianjian to refine the counterfeit silver.
As a result, the alchemists of Qintian Prison began their work, working day and night to bring 996 blessings.
From two days ago, I have been struggling until now. I have been defeated and defeated again and again.
"Caiwei, it's Junior Sister Caiwei." Someone shouted excitedly.
In an instant, haggard faces turned around, and pairs of eyes suddenly lit up.
"Junior Sister Caiwei, how on earth was this fake silver refined?"
"Junior Sister Caiwei, come here and help me see if there is something wrong with the steps? You are the only one who has successfully refined fake silver."
Surround the girl in the yellow dress.
Chu Caiwei had no choice but to enter the alchemy room and watch the senior brothers refining the fake silver.
"Failed again!" an alchemist in white who was operating on site lamented.
"Junior Sister Caiwei, what went wrong?" All the people in white clothes pretended to be asking for advice humbly.
No problem, I made it in the same way at the beginning... Chu Caiwei said in a deep voice: "This is the alchemy passed down in ancient times. It is profound and obscure. It cannot be learned just by learning it. It needs to be taught in a simple and profound way before it can be deeply rooted. I will pass on a formula to all the senior brothers. Remember it."
The senior brothers put on a listening posture.
"Hydrogen, helium, lithium, beryllium, carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, fluorine, neon, sodium magnesium, aluminum, silicon and phosphorus!" Chu Caiwei said this amazing formula word by word.
"Is this a recipe for reconciliation?" The senior brothers didn't know how serious it was. They understood every word and were confused when they put it together.
I don't know what this is... Chu Caiwei pretended to be profound and smiled silently.
"A genius, a genius, the person who wrote this formula is really a genius in alchemy." A senior brother in white sighed with emotion.
Where are the wizards? Senior brother, don’t think so wildly! Chu Caiwei's smile did not change.
"Junior Sister Caiwei, who told you this formula? Did Junior Sister meet an expert in alchemy and get his advice?"
Chu Caiwei said in her heart, good question! He threw the pot lightly.
"That man's name is Xu Qian, the nephew of Xu Pingzhi, the seventh-grade green robe of Yu Daoying. Just look for him."
When they heard that he was a martial artist, the white-clothed people were unhappy.
"It's a joke. I, the great Si Tianjian, have so many talents, but I still need an outsider to refine counterfeit silver?"
"And he's also a martial artist."
"Would it become a joke if word got out?"
Depending on the practice system, several very interesting chains of contempt have been formed.
Taoism looks down on Buddhism, and Buddhism despises it.
Warlocks look down on wizards, wizards look down on Gu Masters, and Gu Masters look down on Warlocks.
Then, Taoism, Buddhism, sorcerers, wizards and Gu masters all looked down on Wu Fu.
As for Confucianism, I'm sorry, but with all due respect, everyone here is rubbish.
However, Confucianism has declined in modern times.
"Junior sister Caiwei, come and guide us."
Caiwei said 'ha': "Next time for sure!"
She forced her way out of the group of senior brothers in white clothes and continued to climb the stairs.
In fact, she doesn't understand either.
Last time I was in the government office, I made fake silver in one go.Hou Caiwei tried again in private and failed.
She completely copied the previous process, but it failed, and she didn't know why.
The roof of the Star Observation Tower is not a normal eaves roof, but an octagonal platform, which coincides with Bagua.
Therefore it is called Bagua Tai.
On the edge of the Bagua table, an old man in white was crouching in front of the case, holding a wine glass in his hand and leaning on his head with the other hand, looking at the capital city below, seemingly drunk but not drunk.
The girl in the yellow skirt was sensible enough not to disturb her. The master did not do any serious work on weekdays. He just liked to sit on the Bagua table, drink and watch the scenery.
I don't like to be disturbed.
Holding a glass of wine and squinting his eyes, he said he was focusing on the world.
"Caiwei is here?" the old man in white said with a smile.
"Master." The girl in the yellow dress smiled and trotted over, standing on the edge of the gossip, her skirt flying.
"What reward does the Emperor have?"
"A few hundred taels of silver and a few bolts of silk and satin." The girl in the yellow skirt said, "Master, what exactly is fake silver?"
"I don't know what the teacher is."
"Is there anything in the world that Master doesn't know about?"
"There are too many." The old man in white said with a smile: "Master doesn't know where those thieves went nineteen years ago."
"You always say that the thieves from nineteen years ago were hateful, but you didn't tell me who they were or what they stole."
The old man in white stood up, stood on the edge of the octagonal platform, and sighed: "What you stole is incredible."
"Then do you know who refined the fake silver?" Si Tianjian is the birthplace of the sorcerer system. Even if the alchemists in the world are not from Si Tianjian, they must be related to Si Tianjian.
Behind the tax money case, there was an alchemist involved, and he was able to refine this kind of strange thing. It was by no means an ordinary person.
"As a teacher, I naturally know."
.......
Small courtyard, main house.
Xu Qian was lying on the bed, staring blankly at the crisscrossing beams through the bright moon shining through the window.
He was worried about his future, a little scared and confused, but also a little excited.
As a high-quality product produced by nine-year compulsory education, all the knowledge in my head is useless.
It is easy to stand out in the backward monarchy society and become the most beautiful flower.
However, a society where imperial power is paramount often means that human rights cannot be guaranteed. A young model in a club today will be exiled to the army tomorrow.
This is a phenomenon that makes any modern person feel sad.
After thinking about it, Xu Qian fell asleep. When he woke up, it was bright. He put on his black official uniform, tied his belt, tied up his long hair, and hung his sword on his waist.
The posture is upright, masculine and handsome.
I have to admit that ancient costumes are good for appearance and temperament, but they are too troublesome when going to the toilet.
I climbed over the wall to have breakfast at my second uncle's house. The uncle and nephew went to work together. Officer Xu Ping resumed his post, and everything was as usual.
Changle County Government Office is Fuguo County of the capital. The government office is in the city, six or seven miles away from Xu's house. Xu Qian did not have a horse or carriage, so he had to take the No. 11 bus and arrived at the county government office in two quarters of an hour.
The Changle County government office faces south. There are two stone lions as tall as a person at the door. On both sides of the red-brown painted door, there are large drums with peeling paint.
The structure of the county government is worth mentioning. The largest one is of course the county magistrate, called the chief official. He has two deputies, one is the county magistrate and the other is the chief registrar.
These three were high-ranking imperial officials. In Xu Qian's era, they were well-established.
Under the three imperial officials, there is Dian Shi, also known as the chief official.
But it has no class and is not popular.
Then there are three classes and six rooms: the third class is the Zao class, Kuai class, and Zhuang class, responsible for ceremonial guard, public security, arrests, etc.; and the six rooms correspond to the six departments of the imperial court.
Xu Qi'an is a guard in the fast squad, and is known as a fast catcher in the public.
After entering the yamen, Li Dianshi, who was standing in front of the hall and saw Xu Qian with a plain knife on his waist and hip, was stunned by the official who happened to be at Dianmao.
That expression was as if the blue sky had seen a ghost.
The government officials noticed that the leader looked wrong and started toThey all turned around to look, and then they had the same ghostly expression.
"Xu, Xu Qian, are you a human or a ghost?!" someone trembled.
Li Dianshi noticed Xu Qi'an's shadow on the ground, felt slightly relieved, and said calmly: "What nonsense are you talking about in the court? Do ghosts have shadows?"
After everyone heard this, they all breathed a sigh of relief.
Xu Qian thought for a while and then continued: "It can't be said that it is a walking corpse."
Li Dianshi was shocked, and all the government officials felt nervous.
Xu Qi'an quickly clasped his fists: "Just kidding, I've met Mr. Dianshi, colleagues, I'm out of prison."
Li Dianshi asked: "What's going on?"
They had heard that the Xu family was imprisoned because of the tax and bank case.
"Naturally, I atone for my sins and make meritorious deeds. The Holy One is tolerant and pardons the Xu family's sins." Xu Qi'an immediately recounted the matter again, but passed the credit to his second uncle and took out the certificate given by the Jingzhao Mansion Yamen.
At the same time, I also knew that although the tax banker had been found, the verdict had not yet been issued, which meant that the case of the tax banker’s disappearance had not yet been settled. After all, the process had to go through, and it was not that fast.
Therefore, this group of government officials in Changle County do not know about this yet.
After midnight, several familiar detectives immediately came over to congratulate him.
"Ning Yan, you have to treat me to a drink."
In this era, when calling friends, use words instead of names. When introducing yourself, use your first name instead of words.
"Yes, if you survive a catastrophe, you will be lucky, so you have to treat me."
"I heard that the Goulan store on Linshui Street has bought a new group of waiters. Ning Yan, will you go with us tonight?"
It's okay to treat guests to drinks, but I want to treat the woman I'm sleeping with. It's too much... Xu Qian was about to shirk it by saying that he had no money, but suddenly he stepped on a hard lump under his feet. When he lowered his head, he saw it was a piece of broken silver.
Is it really true that if you survive a catastrophe, you will be blessed later? He immediately stepped on it and remained calm, pretending to look at the surrounding scenery.
After everyone took a few steps forward, Xu Qian quickly lowered his head to pick it up and put it into his purse without changing his expression.
After walking through the corridor and sitting in the side hall on the west side for a few minutes, Li Dianshi came in with a gloomy face and looked at Wang Captou: "Old Wang, the magistrate asked us to go to the inner hall."
Wang Captou looked bitter and went out without saying a word.
Xu Qian watched Wang Captou disappear and asked, "What's going on? The boss's face doesn't look good."
"In the few days you have been in jail, a murder occurred on Kangping Street. The person who died was a wealthy and powerful businessman. The county magistrate was furious and had to arrest Wang and scold him every day."
"It's just that a businessman died, so there's no need for the magistrate to be furious." Xu Qian ate melon seeds.
Since ancient times, human life has always been a serious matter, but as the magistrate of Guo County, a county in the capital city, from the fifth rank, it is not like this.
"Oh, that businessman is related to a certain adult involved in the matter. I guess it was the pressure from there." The yamen servant said, "Besides, this is the Year of the Gengzi."
"The Year of Gengzi?" Xu Qian didn't respond.
